pageSummary: 已按整条管壁 footprint 复核冻结可见段；膀胱内部仍需橙色固定前景遮住，肺部必须保留外侧供血弧并单独遮住支气管交叉。胃壁两出口保持原位且不占食物通路；精细膀胱与气道 mask、最终合成像素和实际移动尚未验收。

displayDepthContract.coordinateSpace: 1024x1536 source coordinates; every alpha/foreground shares this frame. World mapping and named ports remain frozen.
displayDepthContract.topology: Only a/b stable node identity makes a connection. Projected overlap, a hidden span, or an artwork end cannot create a branch.
renderOrder: frozen visible vessel paint clipped to its lumen footprint
edge-specific source foreground and blood crossing masks
fixed organ rims and bronchial/food foreground
existing named-port annotation, optional technical deep paths
displayDepthContract.vesselFootprintRule: All GPT pigment, pipe wall, highlight, shadow and moving shine share the frozen lumen clip. If effects extend outside the lumen, their maximal support must be declared and tested; existing hide intervals only budget radius + .65 source px. No arbitrary glows.
displayDepthContract.occlusionEdgeRule: Draw visibleSegments with flat hidden ends. Fade only inward along the same path if necessary; never lengthen a short span. Explicit round joint discs only at an existing common named node, clipped by foreground too.
displayDepthContract.foregroundMaskRule: Actual original-pixel alpha masks are required. Source-hashed OrganBoundariesData.lua includes fine bladder outline and safe interior; use those rather than the frozen coarse locator. Fine vectors must still be checked against final source alpha. Source blue pigment alone cannot distinguish vein from airway: restrict branch restoration to reviewed fine lung interior and preserve named blood access.
displayDepthContract.bladderRule: Subtract the exact fixed orange core/rim foreground from ALL painted blood footprints, including e142/e144 approaches and e143/e197/e198 wall exchange. Keep short approaches at existing bladder.entry/exit where outside this foreground. Do not punch the orange core to expose internal nodes or move named ports.
displayDepthContract.lungRule: Preserve e172/e174 outer visible supply arcs and capillary loops, restore fixed light-blue airway source artwork above crossing blood. A named lung supply port hidden by the airway stays an edge-specific deep continuation; do not bridge or attach it to a blue bronchial tip.
displayDepthContract.gastricRule: Both study.stomach.wall_service exits use existing frozen wallSource/normal and clipped wall-only cap marks. They are not holes in the stomach silhouette or openings to food. No renewal of the rejected 0.15 fill art.
displayDepthContract.candidatePassageRule: Candidate invisible food/urine corridors remain depth design constraints, not newly painted foreground anatomy. The existing hidden intervals are preserved conservatively until a reviewed edge-specific depth change exists.
displayDepthContract.protectedBrainLimbs: Do not repaint the 116 protected edges or surrounding original head/limb pixels. No blanket foreground restoration may unexpectedly erase already accepted protected vessels.
displayDepthContract.acceptance: Registered vessel alpha must have zero unauthorized support in blocked foreground, no added shared nodes, unchanged named ports/protected edges, and original outside-scope pixels. Native RTS clearance/movement is a separate test.

displayDepthOverrideProposal.scope: Only the eight enumerated esophagus/rectum exclusions on e006/e008/e174/e175/e142/e197; never all food/urine exclusions or frozen gameplay routes.
displayDepthOverrideProposal.algorithm: Discard listed occlusion records from this separate DISPLAY list; union retained per-edge start/end distances, complement over frozen sampled arc length, render flat-cap lumen footprint. Then subtract exact original airway/food/core/rim/coronary foreground alpha from the whole footprint. Keep overlapping H169/H177 airway exclusions. No centerline relocation, port movement or graph reversal.
displayDepthOverrideProposal.sourceEvidenceLimit: Original bladder.entry and H155/H156 probes are orange face/rim. Those pixels cannot be exposed as visible blood. H056/H069 probes are red heart background, not proof of a blue vein. These are conditional depth proposals, not source-certified visible vessel reconstructions.

highRiskFindings.finding: All five strokes overlap source-traced bladder safe interior. The earlier policy's three-edge list is insufficient by itself: e142/e144 also need the core foreground subtraction.
highRiskFindings.fix: Apply the fixed source orange-face/rim alpha above every local vessel footprint; retain outside-core approaches and all immutable ports.

highRiskFindings.finding: Frozen visible lumen does not reach these ports because invisible candidate food.esophagus/food.rectum depth exclusions hide them. This is not proof of an actually visible opening.
highRiskFindings.fix: Keep hidden continuation explicitly marked in the technical display. Do not force new artwork connectors; genuine visible exposure would require a separately reviewed per-edge display-depth override.

highRiskFindings.finding: An unconstrained one-source-pixel halo overlaps 41 recorded occluders although the frozen visible lumen does not.
highRiskFindings.fix: Clip wall/highlight/shadow/GPT material/flow effects to the lumen, or explicitly recompute and test the maximal expanded support; keep flat hidden caps.

highRiskFindings.finding: Registered main airway corridors do not enumerate every fine light-blue source bronchial twig. Counting source blue alone mixes airway and veins.
highRiskFindings.fix: Restore the source bronchial branch alpha in reviewed fine lung regions, inspect named blood access and test final vessel/bronchial alpha overlap. Preserve the outer e172/e174 arcs.

limitations: Measured areas are geometric sampled-curve footprint units, not biological anatomy.
Occluder tests use fine source traces where available and explicitly coarse/candidate corridors elsewhere; they do not certify pixel-accurate foreground masks.
Orange pixel probes omit rim/highlight pixels and are only independent evidence of wrong visible paint.
No production rendering, new generation, rejected stomach battlefield, full-body performance or gameplay test was performed.
